sandbachFocus: Sandbach United travel to Brereton Social on Saturday looking to bounce back after consecutive defeats dropped them to second place. Despite their recent wobble, Sandbach remain just one point behind leaders AFC Bridgnorth and will be targeting three points against a Brereton side that has won two of their last three games but sit 8th in the table.
divisionWide: AFC Bridgnorth host Shawbury United as they seek to extend their unbeaten run and maintain their narrow lead at the summit. The title race remains remarkably tight, with Eccleshall and Wolverhampton Casuals both within striking distance, and Eccleshall face Dawley Town at home in what should be a winnable fixture. Stafford Town's inconsistent form continues as they host Allscott Heath, while Wolverhampton Casuals take on Bilston Town in a clash between two sides challenging for European positions. In the middle of the table, Foley Meir visit Barnton and Market Drayton Town entertain Cheadle Heath Nomads—both sides looking to secure wins. Alsager Town's poor form (just one win in seven) worsens as they host Crewe, another struggling side with only two wins all season. Wednesfield Community face Telford Town in a bottom-half clash, and Alsager Town v Crewe represents perhaps the division's lowest points total clash this weekend.
